answer.summary: Two deterministic ArchUnit tests failed, so a re-run will likely fail the same way. TenantBackgroundTransactionArchTest flags intra-class @Transactional self-invocations in CatalogListService.offered (calls released) and CatalogScenarioUpdateService.newerVersions (calls installed), both in files this change touches. JsonTypeDirtyOnLoadCoverageTest says the PROBED_FIELDS list no longer matches the JSON-mapped fields in tenant-active tables. Static architecture checks don't flake, and the 2 prior failures for the transaction rule suggest it is a known recurring problem. The rest of the run (1433 tests, 2 failures) looks unrelated.

evidence.quote: org.opentest4j.AssertionFailedError: every JSON-mapped field stored in a tenant-active table needs a case in JsonTypeDirtyOnLoadProbeTest, and nothing else belongs in PROBED_FIELDS.

Rule 'classes should not call a @Transactional method of the same class, because an intra-class call to a @Transactional method bypasses the Spring proxy: no transaction, no tenant scope, silently' was violated (2 times):

Method <io.openaev.service.catalog.scenario.update.CatalogScenarioUpdateService.newerVersions(io.openaev.context.TxCtx, java.lang.String)> calls method <io.openaev.service.catalog.scenario.update.CatalogScenarioUpdateService.installed(io.openaev.context.TxCtx, java.lang.String)> in (CatalogScenarioUpdateService.java:66) self-invokes @Transactional
